title: Tamsin and the Safehouse
premise: Isandro Eastwick, a whistle-blower living under four names, receives a meeting invitation from a handler she watched buried three years ago. Following it into the abandoned safehouse where her training began, she discovers the network that made her is purging its assets one by one, and she is next on the list. With help from a disgraced former archivist who remembers too much, Isandro must decide whether to run again or finally claim her real name and burn the network's records before the dawn extraction flight that will either save or erase her. She chooses to stay, exposes the network to the press mid-flight, and walks out of the safehouse at sunrise as herself for the first time in ten years.
about_author: Cyrus Pemberton is the pen name of a former intelligence analyst turned novelist who writes thrillers about people trapped inside systems they helped build. He lives off-grid on the Cornish coast, where he claims the best plot ideas arrive during power cuts.

chapters.title: The Invitation from a Dead Man
chapters.summary: POV Isandro, living quietly as 'Marion Voss' in Rotterdam, receives an encrypted meeting invite signed by Handler Corrigan—buried three years ago. Her rules say ignore it; her grief says go. The chapter establishes her four identities and the paranoia that governs them. Emotional beat: dread sharpened by longing for the one person who knew her real name.

chapters.title: Safehouse Rules
chapters.summary: POV Isandro enters the decommissioned safehouse outside Ghent where she was trained, finding it staged exactly as it was a decade ago—and Corrigan's cold-case file waiting on the table, marked with her true birth name. A motion sensor trips: someone else is inside. Emotional beat: the uncanny pull of a place that remembers you better than you remember yourself.

chapters.title: The Archivist
chapters.summary: POV alternates between Isandro and Wren Adeyemi, a fired network archivist hiding in the building's sub-basement with stolen drives. Wren reveals the network is executing 'retirement' of all trained assets; Corrigan faked his death trying to stop it. Emotional beat: wary alliance between two people trained never to trust.

chapters.title: Four Names, One Grave
chapters.summary: POV Isandro travels to verify Corrigan's grave and finds it empty, along with evidence that asset retirements are being staged as accidents across Europe. She realizes the invitation wasn't a trap—it was a rescue attempt that arrived too late. Emotional beat: guilt transmuting into resolve.

chapters.title: What the Training Was For
chapters.summary: POV Wren decrypts the drives: the network manufactured whistle-blowers as controlled opposition, feeding curated leaks to protect the powerful. Isandro's entire decade of 'justice' was choreography. Flashbacks to her recruitment fracture her sense of identity. Emotional beat: betrayal so total it feels like losing a language.

chapters.title: Countermeasures
chapters.summary: POV Isandro, now hunted after tripping a network tripwire, uses her own tradecraft against her trainers—burning safehouses, spoofing check-ins, buying hours. Wren maps the network's command node to a private airfield where the extraction flight departs at dawn carrying the archive's master ledger. Emotional beat: competence reclaimed as fury.

chapters.title: The Man Who Buried Himself
chapters.summary: POV Isandro finds Corrigan alive, dying, hidden by an old ally. His confession completes the picture: he recruited her knowing what she'd become, and the invitation was his last act of repair. He gives her the airfield access codes before slipping away to draw pursuers off. Emotional beat: forgiveness offered too late to matter, accepted anyway.

chapters.title: Night at the Airfield
chapters.summary: POV alternates Isandro and Wren infiltrating the airfield under cover of a storm. They plant Wren's drives to broadcast the ledger to every newsroom the network ever manipulated. Security closes in; Wren is captured covering Isandro's approach to the hangar. Emotional beat: terror braided with purpose—the first mission that is truly hers.

chapters.title: Extraction
chapters.summary: POV Isandro boards the plane posing as a retiring asset, confronts the director running the purge mid-flight, and forces the broadcast live before landing. The network's masters wake to their own names in headlines. She trades the master ledger's only physical copy for Wren's release. Emotional beat: climax—ten years of obedience spent in eleven minutes of defiance.

chapters.title: Tamsin
chapters.summary: POV Isandro, at sunrise outside the safehouse, deletes her three false identities and signs a witness statement with her real name: Tamsin Eastwick. Justice will come slowly, through courts and testimony rather than tradecraft, and she chooses to stay and give it. Wren, freed, stands beside her. Emotional beat: quiet, hard-won peace—an identity chosen, not assigned.
